_comment: Classifications for cosmic_diff.py findings, keyed by finding id (a trailing * matches a prefix). Classes: DELIBERATE, BROKEN, RESTORED, UNSURE, UPSTREAM-NEW (Cosmic added it after MapleRoot forked, about Aug 2023, so nothing was stripped), NOISE (detector false positive). Fork point: the Cosmic commit whose tree best matches baseline 03d13cb21 is b46912afc (2023-08-15).

script-commented:scripts/npc/9030000.js:.why: Fredrick (Store Banker) answered 'Sorry, shops are disabled for now.' with the retrieval code commented out. 1.4.0 sells Hired Merchant permits (cashshop/catalog.tsv 5030000-5030xxx) and HiredMerchantRequest/FredrickHandler are stock Cosmic, so items and mesos from an expired or restart-closed merchant could never be claimed. Restored the Cosmic body; hasMerchant/hasMerchantItems/showFredrick are unchanged in NPCConversationManager.
script-commented:scripts/npc/9030000.js:.qa: `!warp 910000000` (FM entrance), click Fredrick with nothing stored: 'You don't have any items or mesos to be retrieved.' `!item 5030000 1`, open the Hired Merchant in an FM room with one item, click Fredrick: 'You have a Merchant open.' Then get the merchant force-closed (test-server restart, which runs closeAllMerchants) and click Fredrick: the Store Banker window lists the item and mesos; retrieve them, check the inventory, click again: 'nothing to be retrieved'.

Expect few or none; many DAMAGE_HACK lines from legit play means the estimate is too low (report, consider USE_AUTOBAN_LOG off).

java-commented:src/main/java/net/server/.why: Owner decision 2026-10-21 (1.4.2, branch gameplay-cosmic-142): restored. Summon hits above calcMaxDamage are clamped again, with Cosmic's DAMAGE_HACK alert and 'Possible exploit' log line (anti-cheat: a packet-edited summon could otherwise deal any damage). The @dps meter counts the clamped damage. Risk: calcMaxDamage is Cosmic's estimate; a MapleRoot custom summon or stat bonus the formula does not know about would see its hits cut. Look for 'Possible exploit' lines from legit play.

java-commented:src/main/java/net/server/.why: Owner decision 2026-10-21 (1.4.2, branch gameplay-cosmic-142): restored, long-safe. Bosses stay immune as in Cosmic. The bounce is bounded by the hit the mage took, so huge mob HP cannot make it explode.

manual:src/main/java/net/server/channel/.why: Owner decision 2026-10-21 (1.4.2, branch gameplay-cosmic-142): restored. Found by hand (deleted, not commented, so the detector misses it): parseDamage had lost Cosmic's crit flag (sign bit on a damage line judged a crit: Snipe, or a crit-capable class hitting above the non-crit estimate), so other players saw everyone's crits as plain hits; applyAttack still decoded the flag. Restored the flag only: Cosmic's fixed 195,000-200,000 Snipe damage stays dropped (MapleRoot uses the client's Snipe damage). A miss is never flagged, and Sacrifice strips the flag before costing HP so a Sharp Eyes crit cannot heal. Risk: if the non-crit estimate is low for MapleRoot stats, some ordinary hits are drawn as crits to others (cosmetic).
manual:src/main/java/net/server/channel/.qa: Two clients in one map. Client A: `!job 412`, `!maxskill 410`, `!maxskill 412`, `!level 120`, `!item 2070006 800` (stars), attack `!spawn 7130100 3`. Client B watches: some of A's numbers are drawn as red/orange crits (before: never). Mobs still lose HP and die normally. Optional: a Dragon Knight with Sharp Eyes using Sacrifice loses HP, never gains it.
